user.title: Access Guard
user.description: Shows who is signed in to Home Assistant and from where, and lets an administrator sign out a single session.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Access Guard is already set up.

data.home_wan_entity: Sensor holding the home's public IP (optional)

data_description.geo_path: Download dbip-country-lite CSV from db-ip.com and put it here. Without it, no country is shown. Nothing is looked up online.
data_description.home_wan_entity: Logins from this address are labelled 'home via internet' instead of 'internet'.

sign_out.name: Sign out a session
sign_out.description: Ends one login (one app or browser) at once. The account stays active and its person can sign in again. Administrators only.

handle.name: Handle
handle.description: The 12-character handle of the login, from the sessions sensor.

sign_out_user.name: Sign out all of a person's sessions
sign_out_user.description: Ends every login of one person. The account stays active and they can sign in again. Administrators only.

user_id.name: User ID
user_id.description: The person's user id, from the sessions sensor.
